description: Where the user downloads a copy of all their TakeMeUp data (account, CVs, AI results, tracker, orders) as a JSON file (GDPR data export). The file opens in their browser while signed in — it isn't sent to the assistant.

locale.description: Language for results and links (en, de, fr, …). Defaults to the language of the user's TakeMeUp account.

name: export_my_takemeup_data
title: Export all my data (GDPR)
